citations.context: And in Galatians chapter 6, verses 7 through 8, Paul says, Do not be deceived. God is not mocked. For whatever a man sows, that he will also reap. For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life. So once again, our good works affect our souls. They help us grow close to God. We reap what we sow.
